owner_decisions: Owner popups 2026-09-30 (recorded in PR #541, docs/governance/OWNER_DECISIONS_2026-09-30.md): 'Allowlisted snapshot (Recommended)'; 'Broad (non-sensitive)'; owner review of the first live dry run 2026-10-02 (Inspector 0.2.0, 1491 ids; docs/governance/OWNER_DECISIONS_2026-10-01.md): street-name and car-status sensors 'Keep them'; personal names 'Share with neutral labels' (owner_name_aliases); rest 'Approve the rest (Recommended)'; health-bridge prefix 'Reserve and block it now (Recommended)' (2026-10-02; owner_deny_prefixes sensor.hb_health_ and binary_sensor.hb_health_); Owner pop-up 2026-10-13 'Both (Recommended)' (Cooling chat): history_list adds house RH, outdoor temperature, outdoor dew point and Vent Start OK; Owner pop-up 2026-10-13 'Exact exception in Inspector' (AI Access chat, Work Board #942 row 56): registry_exempt_entities names the two App-written sensors sensor.house_brain_ai_connectors (AI connector heads-up, AI Access 0.1.5-dev) and sensor.house_brain_ai_kill_switch_effective (kill-switch bridge, AI Access 0.1.3-dev) as exportable without an entity-registry entry; state only (default attributes), every other rule still applies Owner pop-up 2026-10-18 'Build all 4 parts (Recommended)' (Work Board #942 row 72; policy 1.5.0, Inspector 0.2.11): sensor.house_brain_ai_activity (AI Access 0.1.6-dev, state-only, no registry entry) joins registry_exempt_entities, with the scalar attributes total_requests, from and to (counts and dates only; the nested per-AI counts stay unexported). Owner pop-up 2026-10-18 'Both of the above' (Work Board #942 row 74; policy 1.6.0, Inspector 0.2.12): the flat scalar attributes that AI Access 0.1.7-dev adds to sensor.house_brain_ai_activity join its attribute allowlist (flag_summary, which names the AI and flag such as claude:MANY_REFUSED, and per AI the counts <ai>_requests, <ai>_refused, <ai>_rate_limited for claude, chatgpt and grok); counts and flag names only, the nested providers and flags stay unexported.
notes: friendly_name is never exported: person or place names in names cannot be detected reliably.
Excluded entity ids are never reported; the dry-run report carries only per-reason counts and the ids that would be exported.
Every change to this file is an owner-reviewed repository change; owner_deny_* always wins.

owner_name_aliases: personal names are replaced by neutral labels in the exported copy only (entity ids, state and attribute text, history); an exported id that still contains a name word is excluded (NAME_ALIAS_INCOMPLETE). 'ledger' alone is not a name form (sensor.house_brain_learning_memory_ledger).

owner_deny_prefixes: sensor.hb_health_ and binary_sensor.hb_health_ are reserved for the future #56 health bridge and never exported, whatever their content (owner decision 2026-10-02). The builder refuses a policy that claims health_bridge_prefix_in_owner_deny_prefixes without both prefixes (POLICY_HEALTH_PREFIX_NOT_DENIED).

registry_exempt_entities (1.4.0): exact ids only, never a pattern; at most 8; each must be in an exported domain. These House Brain sensors are written by an App through the Core API, so Home Assistant's entity registry never lists them; without this they fail the NOT_IN_REGISTRY rule. Deny lists, blocked domains/devices, device-class and name-category rules, the attribute allowlist and the content detectors still apply.
token_exemptions_rationale: Cooling Arbiter evap pump pulse advice: 'pulse' is a #60 HEALTH token, but these are pump-control advisories, not human health data. Owner-reviewable.
